title: Exaltation of Christ
definition: The exaltation of Christ is His being raised, ascended, enthroned, and glorified after His humiliation and saving work.
summary: Jesus is risen, ascended, enthroned, and highly exalted.
christFocus: Christ's exaltation declares His victory, lordship, priesthood, and coming glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
After His humiliation, suffering, and death, Christ was exalted. He rose from the dead, ascended to the Father's right hand, and reigns with all authority.

His exaltation is not merely reward; it is the public vindication of His person and work. The crucified One is Lord.

The exalted Christ intercedes, rules, sends His Spirit, builds His Church, and will return in glory.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people speak of Jesus as though He remains only a suffering teacher of the past. The exaltation of Christ matters because He is alive and reigning now.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Serve Jesus as the exalted Lord. Let His reign strengthen your worship, prayer, mission, and endurance.
